cad.Pick.doc:
EV2b (ARCH-EMBED §8.5): a native behaviour, `use:pick` from `svelters:behaviors/cad`. While a pick
runs (`active`), its host is a pick target (`cad.pick-target`), hovering it sets `cad.pick-hover`,
and a click reports what the host presents. All of it runs in Rust every frame.

accepts.doc: The value kinds the host presents (the first one is reported).

picked.doc: The host was clicked during a pick.
picked.name: picked

sv.UseAnchored.doc:
`use:anchored`: where a surface of the host's size goes beside `anchor` (`[x, y, width,
height]` in points) inside the window, flipping and shifting to stay visible. Reports
`placed({ side, x, y, width, height })` when the placement changes; the app positions the host.

anchor.doc: The anchor rect: `[x, y, width, height]`.

flip.doc: Flips to the other side when it does not fit.

gap.doc: Points between the anchor and the surface.

matchWidth.doc: The surface is at least as wide as the anchor.

shift.doc: Shifts along the side to stay inside the window.

placed.doc: Where it goes: `{ side, x, y, width, height }`.
placed.name: placed

sv.UseDismissable.doc:
`use:dismissable`: asks to close the host (a popup the app owns) on Escape (with `escape`) or
on a press outside it (with `outside: 'close'`): `dismiss({ reason, x, y })`, `reason` one of
`escape`, `outside-press`.

outside.doc: A press outside the host: `close` asks to dismiss, `ignore` does not.

sv.UseDragToValue.doc:
`use:dragToValue`: dragging on the host scrubs `value` (relative: `speed` per point, Shift
slower, Ctrl/Cmd faster), with `:active` and `:dragging`: `scrub(value)` live, `commit(value)`
at the release, Escape restores.

commit.doc: The value at the release (or the restored one after Escape).
commit.name: commit

sv.UseDraggable.doc:
`use:draggable`: a drag past the platform threshold on the host, with `:dragging`:
`drag({ phase, dx, dy })`, `phase` one of `start`, `move`, `end`, `cancel` (Escape); `dx`, `dy` are
the total movement since the start (along `axis`).

threshold.doc: Points before a drag starts (`null`: the platform's).

sv.UseExpandable.doc:
`use:expandable`: Right/Left on the focused host, AccessKit `Expand`/`Collapse` and (with
`byClick`) a click open and close it; the host gets `:expanded` and AccessKit `expanded`.

expand.doc: The user opened (`true`) or closed it.
expand.name: expand

sv.UseFocusable.doc:
`use:focusable`: makes the host a focus stop (Tab, click-to-focus per platform) with `:focus`
and `:focus-visible` (keyboard or program focus only, never a pointer press).

focusOnClick.doc: A press focuses it (`null`: the platform's rule).

sv.UseHoverable.doc:
`use:hoverable`: the host gets `:hover` (also while disabled, DESIGN R9) and reports entering
and leaving.

hover.doc: The pointer entered (`true`) or left (`false`) the host.
hover.name: hover

sv.UsePressable.doc:
`use:pressable`: the host gets `:active` while pressed and reports presses: `press({ count,
button })` for a click (pointer, Space/Enter on focus, AccessKit `Click`), `down`, `up(inside)`,
`cancel`, and `repeat` while held when `autoRepeat` is set.

activateOn.doc: `press` fires on the press instead of the release.

autoRepeat.doc: Fires `repeat` while held (0.5 s, then every 0.1 s, accelerating).

cancel.doc: The press was cancelled (Escape, focus loss).
cancel.name: cancel

down.doc: A button went down on the host.
down.name: down

up.doc: The button went up: `inside` the host or not.
up.name: up

sv.UseResizable.doc:
`use:resizable`: the host is a sash: dragging it (or the arrows when focused) resizes `size`
along `axis` within `min`..`max`, with `:hover` after the platform's delay, `:active`,
`:dragging` and `:focus-visible`; a double click resets (`collapsible` collapses). Reports
`resize(size)` live and `commit(size)` at the end; Escape restores.

invert.doc: A drag towards the start grows it (a sash on the panel's left or top edge).

size.doc: The size the sash controls, in points.

sv.UseRoving.doc:
`use:roving`: the host's siblings that carry `use:roving` too form one Tab stop; the arrows,
Home and End move focus among the enabled ones (wrapping). Reports the move as `rove(to)`, the
member index it went to.

rove.doc: Focus moved to member `to` (an index among the group's members).
rove.name: rove

sv.UseRovingList.doc:
`use:rovingList`: a highlighted index inside the host (its own rows): the arrows (by
`orientation`), Home and End move it over the enabled items, wrapping with `wrap`.

current.doc: The highlighted item (`-1`: none); the host writes it on hover.

enabled.doc: One entry per item: whether it can be highlighted.

sv.UseScrollable.doc:
`use:scrollable`: the wheel, trackpad momentum, and (with `keys`) the arrows and
PageUp/PageDown/Home/End on the focused host scroll a virtual `content` of
`[width, height]` points through the host's rect: `scroll({ x, y })`, the new offset. The app
draws the content at minus the offset.

keys.doc: The keys scroll when the host is focused.

sv.UseSteppable.doc:
`use:steppable`: on the focused host, the arrows step `value` by `step` (PageUp/PageDown by
`page`, Home/End to `min`/`max`) and the wheel steps it per `wheel`: `step(value)`.

sv.UseToggleable.doc:
`use:toggleable`: a click (or Space/Enter, AccessKit `Click`) toggles; the host gets `:checked`
and `:indeterminate`, and AccessKit `toggled`.

radio.doc: A checked host stays checked on a click (a radio item).

toggle.doc: The user toggled it: `{ checked, indeterminate }`.
toggle.name: toggle

sv.UseTooltipable.doc:
`use:tooltipable`: the platform's tooltip timing on the host (the delay, the follow-on window,
a press hiding it until the pointer leaves, disabled hosts included, R9), for a tooltip the app
draws itself: `tip(true)` to show, `tip(false)` to hide. The common `tooltip` prop needs none of
this.

delay.doc: Seconds before it shows (`0`: the platform's).

duration.doc: Seconds it stays (`0`: until the pointer leaves).

sv.UseTypeahead.doc:
`use:typeahead`: printable keys typed on the focused host within `timeout` build a prefix,
reported as `search(text)` (typing one letter again cycles: the app picks the next match).

timeout.doc: Seconds between keys before the prefix restarts.

a11y.note: Its role, value and actions are what the kind's `Widget::a11y` sets.

cad.CollapsingSection.doc:
RA3, a container kind: `<collapsing-section title="Advanced" bind:open>…children…</collapsing-section>`.
Its children (any elements) are laid out under the header while open (`Widget::layout`) and
drawn with `cx.children(ui)`.

title.doc: The header text, also its accessible name.

speed.doc: How much a pixel of drag changes it.

draws it from its props every frame; its size is what it allocates (measured in a sizing pass).

value.provenance: svelters-egui: egui_kinds_demo::QuantityField writes value with cx.set (observed, exact); its `commit` event carries the committed value

cad.QuantityField.doc: A unit-aware numeric field: `<quantity-field dim="length" bind:value={x} onaccepted={…} />`.

commit.doc:
Commits the text being edited, as Enter does (`bind:value` and `onaccepted` hear it); the SI
value, or null when the text does not parse.

setText.doc:
Replaces the text being edited without committing it (as typing does: `onedited` fires);
returns whether it parses.

valueIn.doc: The committed value in `unit` (one of the dimension's units, e.g. `cm`), or null.

label.doc: The field's label, also its accessible name.

problem.doc: An inline problem shown under the field (the host's validation).

units-shown.doc: Shows the unit after the number.

value.doc: The committed value in SI units; the field shows it in the display unit.

accepted.doc: Enter committed a parsable entry; carries the SI value.
accepted.name: accepted

commit.doc: RA3 (CX3): the committed value, for `bind:value|commit` (same shape as `value`).
commit.name: commit

edited.doc: The text changed (every keystroke); carries the raw text.
edited.name: edited
